title: ConfigDiscoveryIndexingDocument
description: Server-only owner switch stored at config/discoveryIndexing. With no document, or forceNoindex false, the indexing bar decides; forceNoindex true makes every city-by-format page noindex, follow. Any other shape also forces noindex, because a kill switch that cannot be read fails closed. functions/src/cityPlans/indexingOverride.ts parses exactly this shape.
x-owner: the owner in the Firebase console (Admin credentials); read by the hourly city plans rebuild

forceNoindex.description: True keeps every city-by-format page out of search.

reason.description: Why the switch is set, for the next reader.
